name: Michigan Cubing Club Epsilon 2019
information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations

No outside food is allowed at the venue.

There are tentative 2nd rounds for clock, 3BLD, and megaminx (in that order based on how much we get ahead of schedule)

Live results can be found on our [WCA Live page](https://live.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MichiganCubingClubEpsilon2019), which will be available during the competition.
